tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Where Ospitario has public passports: every municipality with at least one, its region (Italy) and country, how many passports (and how many of them unclaimed, tier L0), and its list page. Call it when the traveler names an area, before searching: a place not listed has no passport on Ospitario yet;

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_properties" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_properties, lookup_by_url, get_passport, list_places · Private data: search_properties, lookup_by_url, lookup_by_name, get_passport, list_places · Public sink: send_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_properties, lookup_by_url, get_passport, list_places · Private data: search_properties, lookup_by_url, lookup_by_name, get_passport, list_places · Public sink: send_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
